description: Generalizes ATTRIBUTION_LOCUS_AS_RESIDUAL_PREREG.md's self-directed residual outward -- a held pattern about ANOTHER agent (their regard_for Concept's own live state) instead of oneself. Adds a stability gate (Sternberg 2003's decision/commitment component: confirm_streak >= an effective threshold, base 3 confirmation UNITS at zero arousal) before a Hate marker crystallizes, and gates a motivational removal_desire_for consequence (Fischer, Halperin, Canetti & Jasini 2018's elimination goal) behind that gate, not behind any single angry appraisal. v1.1.0 (HATE_PASSION_COUPLING_PREREG.md) tracks the SAME shared TargetArousal pool shared_arousal.json already built (Sternberg's passion component) and couples the crystallizing incident's removal_desire_for alpha to it. v1.2.0 (HATE_STABILITY_AROUSAL_COUPLING_PREREG.md) additionally scales each confirming incident's own contribution to confirm_streak by 1+arousal_level (Slovic, Finucane, Peters & MacGregor 2007's affect heuristic: a more arousing confirming incident reads as MORE representative of a stable pattern). v1.3.0 (HATE_THRESHOLD_LOWER_BOUND_COUPLING_PREREG.md) additionally lowers the EFFECTIVE threshold itself under arousal (base_threshold/(1+arousal_level), the SAME affect-heuristic citation's second claim: strong affect needs less accumulated evidence before a judgment is treated as settled) -- two independent, additive channels by which passion accelerates crystallization, neither replacing the other. v1.4.0 (HATE_RESET_RESENTMENT_COUPLING_PREREG.md) couples the specific_act RESET too -- instead of an unconditional wipe to 0, confirm_streak is multiplied by arousal_level/(1+arousal_level) (0 at zero arousal, an exact full reset; a positive fraction retained when aroused, per Bodenhausen 1993 -- aroused judgment discounts disconfirming evidence). This retained residue IS this arc's operationalization of resentment: a grievance that persists past a genuine disconfirming act because the act was processed under the same arousal the grievance itself produced. See HATE_ATTRIBUTION_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md, HATE_PASSION_COUPLING_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md, HATE_STABILITY_AROUSAL_COUPLING_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md, HATE_THRESHOLD_LOWER_BOUND_COUPLING_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md, HATE_RESET_RESENTMENT_COUPLING_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md.

rules.name: derive_hate_attribution
rules.comment: HATE_ATTRIBUTION_PREREG.md Sec2: attribution_locus is a RESIDUAL between the incident's own signal and the LIVE regard_for Concept's state (via tracks_concept) -- no prior incident -> first_encounter (hate cannot form on a first impression), signs agree (confirms the held pattern) -> global_other, signs disagree (an exception) -> specific_act. confirm_streak increments by 1+arousal_level on global_other (HATE_STABILITY_AROUSAL_COUPLING_PREREG.md Sec2 -- an aroused confirming incident counts for MORE than one confirmation unit, read via tracks_arousal BEFORE this incident's own update; 0 arousal is exactly the pre-coupling +1), otherwise MULTIPLIES by arousal_level/(1+arousal_level) (HATE_RESET_RESENTMENT_COUPLING_PREREG.md Sec2 -- the resentment residue: at 0 arousal this is an exact full reset to 0, unchanged; elevated arousal retains a fraction of the pre-exception streak instead of fully clearing it, per Bodenhausen 1993's finding that aroused judgment discounts disconfirming evidence). Guarded by status pending->appraised so re-running run_rules() does not double-derive.

rules.name: crystallize_hate
rules.comment: HATE_ATTRIBUTION_PREREG.md Sec2/prediction 5: crystallization requires the STABILITY THRESHOLD, not the first global_other confirmation -- Sternberg 2003's decision/commitment component requires a pattern held over TIME, not a single outburst. HATE_THRESHOLD_LOWER_BOUND_COUPLING_PREREG.md Sec2: the gate now compares confirm_streak against an EFFECTIVE threshold, HATE_STABILITY_THRESHOLD/(1+arousal_level) (== the base constant 3 at zero arousal, LOWER when aroused -- Slovic et al. 2007's affect heuristic: strong affect needs less accumulated evidence before a judgment is treated as settled), read via the SAME tracks_arousal edge derive_hate_attribution already reads. Fires exactly once per TargetPattern (crystallized==0.0 guard).

concepts.name: hate_attribution
concepts.definition: Hate is a global+stable negative attribution about ANOTHER agent, structurally identical to the self-directed global_self/shame attribution but pointed outward, gated by a stability requirement (a pattern held over repeated incidents, not a single outburst) before it crystallizes and motivates a distinct removal/elimination goal.
concepts.why: User: 'build the hate attribution mechanism next' -- following the earlier 'can an agent hate another agent' discussion. HATE_ATTRIBUTION_PREREG.md.
